messages.body:
Hi Dan,

Our records show Biscuit is due for his rabies booster and annual vaccinations. Please book an appointment by {{date:2026-11-20|%B %-d, %Y}} -- call us on 555-0142 or reply to this email with a few times that suit you.

When you come in, please bring a fresh stool sample for his yearly parasite screen and his vaccination record booklet.

Thanks,
Maplewood Vet Clinic front desk
